verses.text: 97. Abba Poemen said, ’If a man has attained to that which the Apostle speaks of ”to the pure, everything is pure,” (Titus 1.15) he sees himself less than all creatures.’ The brother said, ’How can I deem myself less than a murderer?’ The old man said, ’When a man has really comprehended this saying, if he sees a man committing a murder he says, ”he has only committed this one sin but I commit sins every day.” ’
